reason: I like the idea of a proper test with control stores, and it is better than the store trials I run now. But you are brand new with no results, and I am not putting my customers on someone's analytics just because you say your privacy pack covers it.
objection: Filming customers for analytics under the Data Privacy Act. A counsel opinion you paid for is not the same as my own lawyer saying yes, and if a customer complains, it is my chain's name on it, not yours. And PHP 75,000 is real money for me while I wait on a refund.
would_change_my_mind: My own lawyer signing off on the privacy setup, plus talking to one of the other first-round chains after their 8 weeks to see if the result was real.
